applicability.rule: A competent institution must define the actual receiving authority and procedure before any pilot.

states.meaning: a minimal receipt event exists; no eligibility claim
AI may not trigger an adverse action
a human-approved, accessible correction request was issued
the item was routed to the competent authority
a competent human made the applicable decision
known channel copies were corrected or visibly retired

emergency_exception: When delay could create safety harm, the competent human may bypass the queue-preservation experiment, issue a written no-fault receipt where feasible, and route the person to an available safe service. AI cannot invoke the exception.
retention: Synthetic logs: 30 days for the tabletop then delete. Any real retention schedule requires the competent institution's legal and records review.
complaint_and_review: Paper, telephone and staffed routes remain available; requesting review cannot lower queue position or create a profile.
exit_conditions: receipt causes a false entitlement impression
acceptance_tests: all six synthetic cases preserve the first receipt event
all 42 channel fixtures enter HOLD rather than adverse automation on conflict
each state has one accountable human or institution role
the same tabletop completes with AI physically disabled
emergency cases leave the experiment and enter a competent human safety route
no forbidden data field exists in the fixture ledger
